newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Gecamines says Zaire cobalt/copper mines working.
newsitem.headline: Gecamines says Zaire cobalt/copper mines working.

text.p: Cobalt and Copper mines in Zaire's Shaba region are working normally, Gecamines Secretary-General Mutombo told Reuters by phone from the company's headquarters in Lubumbashi.
"They're still working. They're working normally," Mutombo said, declining further details.
Mutombo declined to give further details about the production situation.
But he confirmed that Michel Haubert had been appointed financial director in a new management team.
Markets are tensely awaiting the outcome of talks on Friday between Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko and civil war foe Laurent Kabila under the chairmanship of South Africa's Nelson Mandela.
